# Jan Seva CSC Portal - ડિજિટલ સેવા કેન્દ્ર

## How to run locally:
1. Run: npm install
2. Run: npm run dev
3. Open in browser: http://localhost:3000

### Pages:
- Public Customer Portal: http://localhost:3000
- VLE Admin Console: http://localhost:3000/#admin
- Default Admin PIN: 1234
